title: bwl-osc
description: `bwl-osc` is a bandwidth-limited oscillator that outputs sine, triangle, saw, or pulse waves, with waveshaping for added harmonics, detuned supersaw, and pulse-width modulation. Its pitch control spans 8.175–12543 Hz (MIDI notes 0–127), and its FM and WSHAPE CV inputs have onboard attenuators.
